high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie outdoors on what appears to be a cloudy day. The individual is wearing a bright pink polo shirt with a Ferrari logo on the left chest area. They have long hair tied back and are wearing a blue cap with a white "AA" logo on it. Over their ears, they have black over-ear headphones, and they are also wearing large, dark sunglasses that cover most of their face. The person is also wearing a gray scarf or bandana around their neck, which is partially covering their mouth.
